pages.text: The map is not in the box. It is gone!
Pip the pup sat in the sun. Pip has a bun. Pip has no map.
pages.clue: Pip has a bun, not the map.

pages.text: Ben the cat sat on a mat. Ben has a red hat. The map is not in the hat.
pages.clue: The map is not in Ben's hat.

pages.text: Gus the crab is in the mud. Gus has a big grin. A bit of map is in his hand!
pages.clue: A bit of map is in Gus's hand.

pages.text: Gus had the map. He did not mean to take it. {name} got the map back and Gus got a hug.

questions.nudge: Look back at the picture with the sun.
questions.explain: Pip the pup sat in the sun.

questions.nudge: Think about the order of the pages.
questions.explain: We met Pip, then Ben, then Gus last.

questions.nudge: Which clue says a bit of map was found?
questions.explain: A bit of map was in Gus's hand. That is the clue!
